subscriptionsHint: Paste an iCal subscription link (Google Calendar's "Secret address in iCal format", an Outlook ICS link, an iCloud public calendar link, …). Its events show read-only in Today, Upcoming and Calendar.
subscriptionNamePlaceholder: Defaults to the calendar's own name
error_invalid_url: Invalid link: only http, https and webcal links are supported
error_blocked_address: The link points to a private network address, which the server refuses
error_http_error: The calendar server returned an error (HTTP {{status}})
error_too_large: The calendar file is too large (10 MB limit)
error_not_ics: The link did not return an iCal calendar
